entries.zh: 这张风暴图使用了气象卫星传回的图像。

entries.meaningZh: 处理违章停车的女警察〔旧式非正式称谓〕
entries.en: The retired meter maid kept a photograph of her old police uniform.
entries.zh: 那位退休的停车执法女警察保留着一张旧警服的照片。

entries.en: The technician wrote the meter reading beside the inspection date.
entries.zh: 技术员把仪表读数写在了检查日期旁边。

entries.en: The laboratory compared two reference samples of methadone hydrochloride.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了两份盐酸美沙酮参照样本。

entries.en: The director's workshop explored method acting through short improvised scenes.
entries.zh: 导演的工作坊通过简短的即兴场景探索体验派表演方法。

entries.meaningZh: 戊四氮休克疗法〔历史疗法〕
entries.en: A historical article discussed metrazol shock treatment.
entries.zh: 一篇历史文章讨论了戊四氮休克疗法。

entries.en: He returned the micrometer gauge to its protective case.
entries.zh: 他把测微规放回了保护盒。

entries.en: Her interest in microscopic anatomy began during a laboratory placement.
entries.zh: 她在一次实验室实习期间对显微解剖学产生了兴趣。

entries.en: The physiology class reviewed a diagram of the micturition reflex.
entries.zh: 生理学课上复习了一幅排尿反射示意图。

entries.en: She folded the middy blouse and placed it beside the skirt.
entries.zh: 她叠好水手衫，把它放在裙子旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 骄兵〔拉丁语，古典喜剧角色〕
entries.en: The actor played the miles gloriosus with ludicrous confidence.
entries.zh: 那位演员以滑稽的自信扮演了骄兵角色。

entries.meaningZh: 每加仑汽油能行驶的英里数
entries.en: The petrol car's label reports fuel economy in miles per gallon.
entries.zh: 这辆汽油车的标签用每加仑汽油能行驶的英里数标示燃油经济性。

entries.en: The road sign gives the limit in miles per hour.
entries.zh: 路标以英里每小时为单位标示限速。

entries.en: The archived survey asked participants about milk intolerance.
entries.zh: 这份存档调查询问了参与者有关不耐乳症的情况。

entries.en: The farmer cleaned the milking machine before leaving the dairy.
entries.zh: 农民在离开挤奶房之前清洗了挤奶机。

entries.en: The apprentice measured the part beside the idle milling machine.
entries.zh: 学徒在停机的铣床旁测量了那个零件。

entries.en: The school museum kept a mimeograph machine beside the old newsletters.
entries.zh: 学校博物馆把一台油印机放在了旧通讯刊物旁边。

entries.en: The butcher removed the damaged handle from the mincing machine.
entries.zh: 肉贩从绞肉机上拆下了损坏的手柄。

entries.en: The industrial exhibit explains the main stages of mineral dressing.
entries.zh: 工业展览说明了选矿的主要阶段。

entries.en: The report compares mineral extraction in two mining districts.
entries.zh: 报告比较了两个矿区的采矿情况。

entries.en: The engineering course included a visit to a mineral processing plant.
entries.zh: 这门工程课程安排了一次选矿厂参观。

entries.en: He studied mining geology before joining the exploration team.
entries.zh: 他在加入勘探队之前学习了采矿地质学。

entries.en: The director revised the mise en scene after watching the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 导演看完排练后修改了舞台调度。

entries.en: Moving the misplaced modifier to the start clarified the sentence.
entries.zh: 把误用的修饰语移到句首后，句子变得清楚了。

entries.en: The carpenter checked the miter joint before fitting the frame together.
entries.zh: 木工先检查了斜角连接处，再把框架组装起来。

entries.en: The medical atlas contains an illustration of mitral stenosis.
entries.zh: 这本医学图谱中有一幅二尖瓣狭窄的插图。

entries.en: The heart model opened to reveal the mitral valve.
entries.zh: 心脏模型打开后，露出了二尖瓣。

entries.en: The conference session reviewed research on mitral valve prolapse.
entries.zh: 会议的这一场专题讨论回顾了二尖瓣脱垂研究。

entries.en: The archived case report documented mitral valve stenosis.
entries.zh: 存档病例报告记载了二尖瓣狭窄。

entries.en: A small gap had opened along the mitre joint.
entries.zh: 斜接合处出现了一道小缝。

entries.en: The bartender placed a mixed drink beside the untouched olives.
entries.zh: 调酒师把一杯混合鸡尾酒放在了没人动过的橄榄旁。

entries.en: The farm adopted mixed farming, combining sheep with grain crops.
entries.zh: 这家农场采用多种经营，兼营养羊和粮食种植。

entries.en: The editor laughed at the mixed metaphor in the opening paragraph.
entries.zh: 编辑看了开篇段落中的混合隐喻后笑了起来。

entries.en: The textbook classified the fictional disturbance as a mixed nuisance.
entries.zh: 教材把那起虚构滋扰事件归为混合妨害。

entries.en: The plumber replaced the mixing faucet above the washbasin.
entries.zh: 水管工更换了洗脸盆上方的冷热水混合龙头。

entries.meaningZh: 摩卡咖啡〔此处为传统咖啡名称〕
entries.en: The café served mocha coffee made from beans imported from Yemen.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应的摩卡咖啡用从也门进口的咖啡豆制成。

entries.en: The teacher underlined the modal auxiliary in the student's sentence.
entries.zh: 老师在学生句子中的情态助动词下面画了线。

entries.en: The philosophy seminar connected modal logic with questions about possibility.
entries.zh: 哲学研讨课把模态逻辑与有关可能性的问题联系起来。
